solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: One is in top spot

parts.note: the phrase 'top spot' reads the same backwards letter by letter, so it is an example of the thing defined

explanation.surface: Someone or something is sitting in first place at the top of a league.
explanation.walkthrough: Read 'top spot' as a phrase to be inspected rather than a position: spelt backwards it is still 'top spot'.
explanation.definitionFit: A word or phrase that reads identically in both directions is the term defined, and 'top spot' is one such example.

clue.text: One is growing up in custody of old man

indicators.note: being held in someone's custody means being kept inside, so one piece goes within the other

parts.note: old man is a familiar term for father, shortened to pa

explanation.surface: A youngster is being raised while in the care of their father.
explanation.definitionFit: An insect in its chrysalis stage is still developing between larva and adult, so it is one that is growing.

clue.text: One is asked by lawyer taking digs at queen to change into celebrity

indicators.note: the rearranged letters are put into the middle of the word for a celebrity

parts.note: a lion is a celebrated person, as in a literary lion

indicators.note: to change signals that the letters of digs at queen are rearranged

explanation.surface: A barrister mocks the monarch while pressing a famous witness under cross-examination.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to change' rearranges DIGS AT QUEEN into EADINGQUEST, which goes 'into' LION.
explanation.definitionFit: A courtroom question phrased to prompt the desired reply is the kind a barrister puts to a witness.

clue.text: One is sick of interference

indicators.note: sick suggests something upset or disordered, so the letters of the two words before it are jumbled

explanation.surface: Someone is fed up with being meddled with.
explanation.definitionFit: In electronics, unwanted signals that disturb reception are called by this name, a synonym for interference.

clue.text: One is depending on shock win, mostly, in game

indicators.note: the shortened word for win is placed inside the abbreviation for the game

parts.note: RL is short for rugby league

indicators.note: mostly means the word is used except for its last letter

parts.note: to win something is to attain it

explanation.surface: Someone is relying on a surprise victory in a match.
explanation.walkthrough: 'depending' means hanging down, and 'shock' is a mass of hair, not a surprise. RL is rugby league.
explanation.definitionFit: A thin lock of hair left hanging long at the back of the head is this hairstyle, dangling from a shock of hair.

clue.text: One is rubbing me around bottom, extremely unfair

indicators.note: around means the word me surrounds the word for bottom

parts.note: ass is a slang word for the bottom

indicators.note: extremely picks the outermost letters, first and last, of the next word

explanation.surface: Someone groping a person's rear is an outrageous liberty.
explanation.definitionFit: A professional who kneads muscles for a living is a person whose job is rubbing clients.

clue.text: One is on run in this

definitions.text: One is on run in this

indicators.note: in an across entry being on something means coming after it

parts.note: R is the cricket abbreviation for run
an ace is the card with one pip

explanation.surface: A competitor is running in a contest.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue is both the wordplay and a fair description: an athlete is on the run in a sprint.
explanation.definitionFit: A competition of speed is an event where every entrant is on the run.

clue.text: One is in a scrum so might cause ill feeling

indicators.note: might cause signals the letters of the words before it produce something new when rearranged

parts.words: One is in a scrum so

explanation.surface: Being trapped in a rugby scrum could make a player resentful.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole run 'One is in a scrum so' is the fodder; 'scrum' looks like the anagram signal but is part of it.
explanation.definitionFit: Bitterness and rancour between people is ill feeling, the noun for bitter hostility.

clue.text: One is in pornographic supporting role, ultimately justified?

indicators.note: in a down entry, supporting means lying beneath, so the film-rating piece comes below
ultimately points to the final letter of the word role
is in means the word one sits within the rating word

parts.note: an X-rated film is one classed as pornographic

explanation.surface: An actor justifies taking a minor part in an adult film.
explanation.walkthrough: 'supporting' puts E above X-RATED, since this is a down clue.
explanation.definitionFit: Being cleared of blame means being shown to have acted rightly, hence justified, with the question mark softening the stretch.

clue.text: One is removed from coal fires raging outside

indicators.note: is removed from says the letter for one is taken away from the fodder
raging suggests something wild and disordered, so the remaining letters are shuffled

parts.note: the Roman numeral for one is I

explanation.surface: Someone is dragged away from blazing coal fires.
explanation.walkthrough: Take I out of COAL FIRES and 'raging' rearranges what is left.
explanation.definitionFit: This Italian-derived term describes eating or doing things in the open air, i.e. outside.

clue.text: One is in orchestral setting?

indicators.note: the two short words go inside the word for where an orchestra plays

parts.note: the orchestra pit is where a theatre orchestra sits
an is the indefinite article, meaning one

explanation.surface: Someone is among the players in an orchestra.
explanation.walkthrough: 'One is' splits into two words, the article and the verb, not the usual I. The whole clue also describes the answer, since a theatre pianist may play from the pit.
explanation.definitionFit: A keyboard player may sit among the musicians in a theatre's sunken orchestra area.

clue.text: One is keeping right and left while going around port

indicators.note: going around means everything built so far is turned to read backwards
is keeping means the word one holds the letter for right inside it

parts.note: as can mean while, as in 'as I was leaving'

explanation.surface: A sailor keeps to the right and left while steering round a harbour.
explanation.walkthrough: ONRE + L + AS gives ONRELAS, which 'going around' reverses.
explanation.definitionFit: A city on the Gulf of Salerno in southern Italy is a seaport, so it is an example of a port.

clue.text: One is after a cherry 24 for dog

indicators.note: is after means the letter for one follows the word a

parts.note: the Roman numeral for one is I
cherry is a shade of red
the answer to 24 down is a drink, and ale is a kind of it

explanation.surface: Someone is out for a cherry beer, for the hair of the dog.
explanation.definitionFit: A large wiry-coated terrier from Yorkshire is a breed of dog.

clue.text: One is captivated by headless body in plant

indicators.note: being captivated is being held captive, so the letter for one is held inside
headless means the first letter of the word for body is dropped

parts.note: a person's frame is their body
the Roman numeral for one is I

explanation.surface: Someone is spellbound by a decapitated corpse in a factory.
explanation.definitionFit: An Asian nettle grown for its strong fibre is a plant species.

clue.text: One is potential evidence wasted on tabloids

indicators.note: wasted means ruined or smashed up, so the letters of the two words after it are rearranged

explanation.surface: Something that could prove a case is squandered by being leaked to the tabloids.
explanation.definitionFit: A mark of dried blood at a crime scene could be used as proof in court.

clue.text: One is breaking record, state being consistent

indicators.note: is breaking means the letter for one splits open the combined pieces

parts.note: a log is a written record, as in a ship's log
Cal is an abbreviation for California, a US state
the Roman numeral for one is I

explanation.surface: An athlete is breaking a record, the state's performance being steady.
explanation.definitionFit: Reasoning that holds together without contradiction is coherent, so the word works as a synonym for consistent.

clue.text: One is in church with an aim to welcome one?

definitions.text: One is in church with an aim to welcome one?

indicators.note: to welcome means to take in, so the word for aim holds the letter for one

parts.note: a plan is an aim or intention
the Roman numeral for one is I

explanation.surface: A cleric is in church with the intention of greeting a visitor.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue describes the answer as well as building it.
explanation.definitionFit: A clergyman attached to an institution such as a college or hospital serves in church and welcomes all comers.

clue.text: One is leaving 27 after backing a short kind of girl

indicators.note: after means the trimmed girl's name comes after the reversed part
backing means the two pieces before it are read backwards
short means the word for kind loses its last letter

parts.note: a sort is a kind or type

indicators.note: is leaving means the letter for one departs from the word it is in

parts.note: the answer to 27 across is a girl's name
the Roman numeral for one is I

explanation.surface: A girl is walking out on her friend after supporting some unfinished project.
explanation.walkthrough: A SOR (short SORT) is reversed by 'backing' to give ROSA; NINA losing I is NNA.
explanation.definitionFit: The name is a female forename, so it fits the general word for a girl.

clue.text: One is gutted about volunteers, darling, returning to supply eggs

indicators.note: about means the gutted word wraps round the reversed pieces
gutted means the insides are removed, keeping only the outer letters of the word one
returning means the two pieces are read backwards

parts.note: TA is the Territorial Army, Britain's volunteer reserve
luv is an informal spelling of love, a term of endearment like darling

explanation.surface: Someone is devastated by volunteers, their beloved going back to deliver supplies of eggs.
explanation.walkthrough: 'returning' turns TALUV into VULAT; the TA is the Territorial Army, Britain's volunteer reserve force.
explanation.definitionFit: When a female releases an ovum from the ovary she produces eggs, which is what this verb means.

clue.text: One is trying to find voice in limitless desert

indicators.note: the word for speaking up goes inside the trimmed word
limitless means the word desert loses its first and last letters

parts.note: to find voice is to speak, to say something

explanation.surface: Someone is struggling to make themselves heard in an endless wilderness.
explanation.definitionFit: To essay something is to attempt it, so the agent noun means a person who makes an attempt.

clue.text: One is supporting huge electronic advance

parts.note: a prop is one that is supporting something, such as a beam
OS is short for outsize, meaning huge
E is short for electronic, as in e-mail

explanation.surface: A backer is funding a massive leap forward in electronics.
explanation.definitionFit: To put forward an idea or plan for consideration is to advance it, a synonym.

clue.text: One is in business with 3 — sign of return?

indicators.note: is in means the letter for one sits inside the abbreviation for a company

parts.note: PLC is a public limited company, a business
the Roman numeral for one is I
the answer to 3 down means noise, and a row is a noise or din

explanation.surface: Someone is in business with a noisy partner, a sign they will be back.
explanation.walkthrough: PLC is the British abbreviation for public limited company.
explanation.definitionFit: The paragraph mark ¶ was used to mark where a new line starts, much like a carriage return symbol.

clue.text: One is gathered by girl turning over fibre

indicators.note: turning over means the combined piece is flipped to read backwards
being gathered by someone means being taken in by them, so the letter goes inside

parts.note: a lass is a girl
the Roman numeral for one is I

explanation.surface: Someone is scooped up by a girl as she turns over some fibre.
explanation.walkthrough: I inside LASS gives LASIS, which 'turning over' reverses.
explanation.definitionFit: The Mexican agave leaf yields a stiff fibre used for rope and matting.

clue.text: One is in court representing gaffer?

parts.note: sole means single or one, as in the sole survivor

indicators.note: the word is goes inside the abbreviation for court

explanation.surface: Someone is in court acting on behalf of the boss.
explanation.walkthrough: 'gaffer' looks like a foreman or boss, but here it means someone who makes gaffes.
explanation.definitionFit: A person who commits blunders in grammar or etiquette makes gaffes, so is jokingly one who gaffes.

clue.text: One is not going all the way, chasing better cock

indicators.note: chasing means following, so the shortened word comes after the word for better

parts.note: to cap something is to better or outdo it

indicators.text: is not going all the way
indicators.note: not going all the way means the word stops short, losing its final letter

explanation.surface: Someone holds back from going the distance, pursuing a superior cockerel.
explanation.definitionFit: A castrated male chicken fattened for the table is a type of cock.

clue.text: One is apparently a drink

parts.note: is is a form of the verb to be
the suffix -er means one who, as in baker or runner

explanation.surface: Someone is seemingly a drinker.
explanation.walkthrough: A person who simply is would be a 'be-er': BE from 'is' plus the agent suffix ER from 'One'. 'apparently' signals the coinage.
explanation.definitionFit: Brewed from malted barley and hops, it is a common alcoholic drink.

clue.text: One is keen to have this heartless song on video?

definitions.text: One is keen to have this

indicators.note: in an across entry, on means placed after, so the song follows the video piece

parts.note: AVI is a common video file format

indicators.note: heartless means one of the middle letters of the song word is removed

parts.note: a ditty is a short simple song

explanation.surface: Someone is eager to have a soulless song turned into a music video.
explanation.walkthrough: AVI (Audio Video Interleave) is a computer video file format.
explanation.definitionFit: Eagerness or greed is the quality someone keen possesses, so this noun is what a keen person has.

clue.text: One is finished after theatre rent charged

indicators.note: after means the final letter comes after the theatre and rent pieces

parts.note: rep is short for repertory theatre
to let a property is to rent it out

indicators.note: is finished points to where the word ends, its last letter

explanation.surface: A tenant is through with a theatre where the rent was charged.
explanation.definitionFit: Being filled to the brim means being loaded or charged, as a glass is charged.

clue.text: One is near oddly abandoned girl

indicators.note: oddly abandoned means the letters in odd positions are dropped, keeping the even ones

explanation.surface: Someone is close to a girl left strangely deserted.
explanation.definitionFit: The name is a female forename, so it stands for a girl in general.

clue.text: One is flattering client about Newsround?

indicators.note: about means the word for the client program goes around the other piece

parts.note: a web browser is a client program in computing
split as news (NN, the plural of n, short for news) and round (O, a round shape)

explanation.surface: Someone is sweet-talking a client about a children's news programme.
explanation.walkthrough: Newsround is a long-running BBC children's news programme; here it splits into NN and O.
explanation.definitionFit: This slang term for a sycophant describes someone who flatters superiors to curry favour.
